name: 37217 · Nashville, TN
findings: ZIP 37217 (Nashville) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37217 (Nashville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
